description: This file defines the CommandResponse interface, which is part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It aggregates possible responses related to commands, including methods for status and type information, JSON serialization, and common JSON field definitions.

classes.name: CommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains common JSON field definitions for command responses, including type, status, and payload fields.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for this response.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the schema version that this response implements, defaulting to the latest if not specified.

methods.name: isOfExpectedResponseType
methods.description: Checks if this response is of a type contained in the expected response types header.

methods.name: getResponseType
methods.description: Returns the response type, defaulting to RESPONSE.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with this response.

methods.name: getStatusCodeValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the status code.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command response to a JSON object including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command response to JSON with a specified schema version and predicate.
